## Block name
`dataset`

## Purpose
Declare training/eval data.

## Fields
- `path: Path` — filesystem path.
- `format: DatasetFormat` — closed enum {json, jsonl, csv, parquet}.

## Grammar example
```hcl
dataset "training" { path = "./train.jsonl", format = jsonl }
```

## LANGUAGE-SPEC §4.16 snippet
(omitted for brevity)

## Decision implications
- New `RefKind::Dataset` (eval blocks reference it).
- Standard duplicate-label check.

## Block name
`webhook`

## Purpose
Fire HTTP POST on pipeline lifecycle events.

## Fields
- `url: Url` — HTTPS only.
- `events: List<WebhookEvent>` — closed enum {start, complete, fail}.
- `secret: Ref<Secret>?` — optional HMAC signing.

## Grammar example
```hcl
webhook "deploys" { url = "https://hook.example/h", events = [complete, fail] }
```

## LANGUAGE-SPEC §4.17 snippet
(omitted)

## Decision implications
- New `RefKind::Webhook`? no — webhook is leaf-only.
- URL scheme=https check.

## Block name
`cache`

## Purpose
Memoise skill output.

## Fields
- `skill: Ref<Skill>` — cached skill.
- `ttl: Duration` — 1s..=24h.
- `key_template: String` — MiniJinja template.

## Grammar example
```hcl
cache "search_results" { skill = skill.web_search, ttl = 1h, key_template = "{{ args.query }}" }
```

## LANGUAGE-SPEC §4.18 snippet
(omitted)

## Decision implications
- No new RefKind.
- TTL range check at parse time.
- Decision 44.4: cache writes under `.aislang/cache/`.
